reading_title_html: The Alarm Nobody Stopped to Read

reading.rtitle: The Alarm Nobody Stopped to Read
paras: At 0341 the general alarm sounded on the main switchboard. It continued for eleven minutes. The officer of the watch watched it for two minutes. He decided that the malfunction was in the sensor, so he stopped monitoring the alarm. He did not stop to read the fault code. That takes fifteen seconds, and the code said the fault was in the circuit.

The company procedure is clear. On a repeated alarm, the officer must record the code and call the engine room. The officer had signed the checklist three days before. He remembered signing it, but he did not remember checking anything.

Then the master tried running the section on the emergency generator. This step was not in the contingency plan. It worked for forty minutes. Then it failed, and the ship lost steering for two minutes in a narrow channel.

The report says the officer regretted not reading the code. The notification to the company was four hours late. The hazard was known, the procedure existed and the checklist was signed, but none of this changed what happened.

tf: The officer paused in order to read the fault code.
The text says 'He did not stop to read the fault code'. Stop to do = pause in order to do something.
The officer ceased watching the alarm after two minutes.
The text says he watched it for two minutes and then 'stopped monitoring the alarm'. Stop doing = the activity ended.
The officer could recall putting his signature on the checklist.
The text says 'He remembered signing it'.
Using the emergency generator was part of the contingency plan.
The text says 'This step was not in the contingency plan'.
The company was informed at once.
The text says 'The notification to the company was four hours late'.
grammar_head: The Four Pairs That Change the Operation
grammar_sub: stop, remember, try, regret: read the second verb

grammar_examples.html: He did not stop to read the fault code.
grammar_examples.say: He did not stop to read the fault code.

grammar_examples.html: The master tried running the section on the generator.

grammar_question: For each sentence, write what really happened. Example: sentence 1 = he was watching, then he was not watching.
grammar_rows: the activity ended / pause in order to do something
He stopped monitoring it = he was not watching any more. He stopped to read the code = he paused and read it.
remember a past action / do not forget a future job
He remembered signing it = he signed it before. Remember to sign it = sign it later.
test a method / make an effort to do something difficult
He tried running it on the generator = he tested this method.
be sorry about the past / formal start of bad news
He regretted not reading the code. We regret to inform you...
the two forms are two different events. A wrong option in the exam changes stopped monitoring into stopped to monitor and keeps all the other words.
grammar_insight: You do not need to write these pairs perfectly. You need to read the second verb and know what really happened.
grammar_practice: He stopped monitoring the alarm. = He was watching the alarm, and then he
He did not stop to read the code. = He did not
He remembered signing the checklist. = He
The master tried running it on the generator. = He
We regret to inform you. = This is the start of
spot: He stopped to monitor the alarm and never looked at it again.
He stopped monitoring the alarm and never looked at it again.
He remembered to sign the checklist three days before the alarm.
He remembered signing the checklist three days before the alarm.
The master tried to run the section on the generator, as a test.
The master tried running the section on the generator, as a test.
We regret informing you that the ship has been stopped.
We regret to inform you that the ship has been stopped.

quickfire.situation: He stopped monitoring the alarm. Write: is he watching it now? Yes or no, and one reason.
tips: No. Stop + -ing means the activity ended.
Stop to watch would mean he paused in order to watch it.

quickfire.situation: He remembered signing the checklist. Write: did he sign it before or after remembering?
tips: Before. Remember + -ing looks back at a past action.
Remember to sign looks forward: sign it later.

quickfire.situation: Complete in writing: The master tried ___ the section on the emergency generator.
tips: Try + -ing: he tested a method to see if it would work.

quickfire.situation: An option says: the officer stopped to read the fault code. Write True or False and copy the line.
tips: The line: He did not stop to read the fault code.

quickfire.situation: Write in exam words: Nobody told the company for four hours.
tips: The company was not informed until four hours later.
Also: Notification to the company was delayed.

quickfire.situation: Write one sentence with two words from today: hazard, precaution, checklist, procedure.
tips: Example: The officer signed the checklist but did not follow the procedure.

listenings.sub: The officer of the watch, six weeks later. Sound first, no text.
listenings.text: I want to be accurate about this. I did not ignore the alarm. I watched it for two minutes. I decided it was the sensor, and then I stopped watching it. What I did not do, and what I regret, is stop to read the fault code. It takes fifteen seconds. The code would have told me the fault was in the circuit, and I would have called the engine room one hour earlier. Yes, I was on watch for eleven hours. That is not an excuse. Many people work eleven hours and read the code. I remember signing the checklist. I do not remember checking a single item on it.
questions: How long did he watch the alarm?
For two minutes. Then he stopped watching it.
Not stopping to read the fault code. It takes fifteen seconds.
What does he remember about the checklist?
He remembers signing it, but not checking any item.

grammar_tip_lead: With four verbs, the second verb changes the fact: stop, remember, try, regret. Read the second verb first. You only need to read it and know what really happened.

teacher.s1: Abertura (1 min): Aula no NIVEL NOVO (pedido da professora em 28/09): texto mais curto, frases simples, glossario na tela, 1 listening so e as respostas por ESCRITO. A prova e 100% leitura. Os quatro pares de verbo hoje sao para LER e saber o que aconteceu, nao para produzir.
teacher.s2: Homework check + warm-up (4 min): Ela le UMA oracao relativa que sublinhou e escolhe um chip. Uma frase basta. Se o criterio for so faz sentido, volte ao slide 3 da aula 6.
teacher.s3: Provocacao (3 min): Ela escolhe A ou B. Espere 5 segundos. Resposta: B (stopped to monitor = ele parou PARA olhar). Depois pergunte, com opcoes: in the first sentence, is he watching now, yes or no? (No.)
teacher.s4: Objetivo (1 min): Leia as tres missoes. Diga: today you answer in writing.
teacher.s5: Transicao vocab (1 min): Diga: Ten words for when something goes wrong. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s6: Vocab reveal 1-4 (4 min): procedure, malfunction, alert, deviation. NAO traduza. CCQ com opcoes: Deviation: is it always a mistake, yes or no? (No: e uma mudanca do plano.)
teacher.s7: Vocab reveal 5-7 (4 min): contingency, drill, hazard. CCQ com opcoes: Hazard: before or after the accident? (Before: e a fonte de perigo.)
teacher.s8: Vocab reveal 8-10 (4 min): checklist, precaution, notification. CCQ com opcoes: Precaution: before or after? (Before.)
teacher.s9: Consolidate (3 min): Ela liga os pares sozinha. Ajude so se ela pedir.
teacher.s10: Transicao leitura (1 min): Diga: Eleven minutes of alarm. O proximo slide e o de TAREFA: a pergunta ANTES do texto.
teacher.s11: Leitura (7 min): Leitura silenciosa. Mostre o GLOSSARIO antes. Avise UMA vez: o segundo verbo decide o fato. Se ela travar numa palavra fora do glossario, de um sinonimo simples em ingles.
teacher.s12: Gist (2 min): Ela escolhe a opcao e ESCREVE a linha que prova. Resposta: (c). (a) e (b) nao sao o ponto do texto.
teacher.s13: True or False (5 min): Ela responde as cinco e escreve a linha que prova cada uma. A 1 e a 2 sao o par stop to do / stop doing: sao a aula inteira.
teacher.s14: Transicao gramatica (1 min): Diga: Four verb pairs. You only need to read them. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s15: Grammar discovery (6 min): Para cada exemplo, ela ESCREVE o que aconteceu. So entao clique Reveal the Rule. CCQ com opcoes: He remembered signing it: did he sign it, yes or no? (Yes.)
teacher.s16: Practice (4 min): Ela escreve o que aconteceu ANTES de clicar. Aceite qualquer versao simples correta.
teacher.s17: Spot the error (3 min): As quatro frases erradas sao gramaticalmente corretas: o erro e de SENTIDO contra o texto. Diga isso antes.
teacher.s18: Transicao equivalencia (1 min): Diga: Same eleven minutes, other words. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s19: Como a prova esconde (3 min): Leia os quatro pares com ela. O terceiro (ceased to observe) tem infinitivo e mesmo assim significa parar de fazer: stop e a excecao.
teacher.s20: Equivalencia (4 min): Ela liga os pares. Ajude so depois de 5 segundos.
teacher.s21: Complete (4 min): Uma lacuna por vez. As oito respostas estao no banco de palavras.
teacher.s22: Quick fire POR ESCRITO (6 min): Ela escreve a resposta de cada uma no chat ou no papel, e so depois voces abrem as dicas. A quarta reproduz o distrator real da prova.
teacher.s23: Transicao (1 min): Diga: One recording, then you write. Passe ao proximo.
teacher.s24: Listening (5 min): O UNICO listening da aula (pedido da professora). LEIA AS 3 PERGUNTAS EM VOZ ALTA COM ELA ANTES de tocar. Primeira vez em 0.75x, segunda em 1x. O audio usa tres dos quatro pares: peca que ela marque quais, com opcoes.
teacher.s25: Writing (5 min): Ela escreve tres frases sobre o oficial, uma por inicio. Corrija por escrito so o essencial (verbo e palavra tecnica). Depois clique Show a Model Answer.
teacher.s26: Escrita guiada (5 min): Quatro frases com os inicios. Conte quantos pares ela usa certo, sem exigir.
teacher.s27: Escrita semi-livre (5 min): Para dois pares, ela escreve o que a OUTRA forma significaria. Use as opcoes do banco de palavras se ela travar.
teacher.s28: Producao (4 min): Ela ESCREVE tres frases e depois LE em voz alta. Esse e o unico momento de fala da fase: curto e com roteiro.
teacher.s29: Transicao wrap-up (1 min): Diga: Let us see what you can do now.
teacher.s30: Survival card (3 min): Cinco frases do texto. Toque e peca repeticao, uma vez cada. Ritmo: stopped MOnitoring x stopped to READ.
teacher.s31: Checklist (2 min): Leia cada item em voz alta. Os 5 checks fecham a aula e acendem o stamp.
teacher.s32: Encerramento (2 min): Diga: Lesson 7 complete, Helena. HOMEWORK ORALMENTE, nunca escrito na tela: (1) escrever quatro pares de frases, a mesma situacao nas duas formas (stop, remember, try, regret); (2) achar num texto tecnico em ingles duas ocorrencias de stop, remember, try ou regret e escrever o que aconteceu. Proxima aula: The Language of Maritime Safety.
teacher.s25b: Writing: os quatro fatos (5 min): Uma frase por fato, em ordem (alarm, officer, master, ship). Se ela travar, aponte o paragrafo do texto. Depois clique Show a Model Answer e compare.
